description: Report one monitor's uptime for each UTC day, oldest first and ending today, to find the day an outage or degradation began. Each day has date, uptime_percentage, total_checks, up_checks, down_checks, degraded_checks and maintenance_checks; a degraded check counts as up, and a day with no checks outside maintenance has a null uptime_percentage, not 100. For 24h, 7d and 30d totals use get_uptime_summary. Returns monitor_id and days.

days.description: How many days to return, 1 to 365; default 30. Capped at the plan's limits.history_retention_days (get_plan_usage), so fewer days can come back.

monitor_id.description: The monitor's uuid from list_monitors. An id that is not a monitor of this organization, or a deleted one, is a 404.

name: get_uptime_daily
title: Get a monitor's daily uptime
